id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_090.pack|cs_: Show yourself, Darkspawn {var:1}! I know you're lurking somewhere in this town!
If you don't come out soon, I'll take this man's life!
That officer is so short-tempered. We must hurry or Erik is in danger, but charging in head-on is a bad bet...
I know! There should be a passage from the northwest gondola landing around behind the stage. Let's sneak up that way!
Jump down from here and take a gondola along the town canal, and we can get there! Now, let's go rescue Erik!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_100.pack|cs_: Still not found, you useless lot?! I can handle guarding this small fry alone. Go search for {var:1} again!
{var:1}, our chance! Take down that officer while we can and rescue Erik!
How did you get all the way here?!
Scurrying, annoying rats! I'll settle things with you and the Darkspawn all by myself!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_080_cs_120.pack|cs_: Master Erik, are you safe?! We'll free you right now!
Darkspawn {var:1} and your gang! How dare you hurt Lord Jasper!
...Defeating me changes nothing. You are fated to be caught here!
Everyone, relax! It's all right now!
Ha ha ha! So your friends run off and leave you. That's all the bond with your companions amounts to, {var:1}.
You gave me quite a bit of trouble, but tonight's show ends here.
Surrender quietly to me, or fall into the sea and become shark bait. Choose, here and now!
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! Your Sylvando ship is here to pick you up!
Alice! Those are my friends! Sail as close to the pier as you can!
Ta-ta, Jasper darling! Tonight's show was rather fun. Adieu!
What shall we do, Lord Jasper...? At this rate they'll escape.
Heh... filthy sewer rats. Don't think you can escape Jasper...
